# `AuthenticationService.login`

`AuthenticationService.login` securely handles the auth token and performs a simple operation that validates the supplied email address while it efficiently manages all of the important user authentication things in the application.

### Parameters

- `email` (`number`): The email address.
- `unknown` (`string`): An unknown value.

## Returns

`User`

## Errors

- `NetworkError`: The network failed.

Read more [here](../README.md).

`AuthenticationService.login` returns `User`.
`AuthenticationService.login` calls `missingOperation`.
